title: Verify: Player contributions route unit tests
summary: Unit tests for new and legacy contribution history paths
description: Add subtests to backend/internal/server/server_test.go using httptest and a temp-dir repo, proving the new path serves Mine and the legacy path no longer does.
acceptance_criteria: Given a session cookie and round_id, when the new path is requested, then 200 and an empty JSON array body
Given a session cookie, when the legacy path is requested, then 404
Given no cookie, when the new path is requested, then 401
technical_constraints: Use t.TempDir() for Storage.RepoPath; no network

steps.action: Build cfg like TestNew_RegistersRoutes; create a session via POST /api/v1/player/session and copy its cookies; add subtests: GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions?round_id=ROUND-0000001 with cookies expects 200 and body []; GET /api/v1/contributions/mine?round_id=ROUND-0000001 with cookies expects 404; GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions?round_id=ROUND-0000001 without cookies expects 401
steps.code: h.ServeHTTP(rec, req); if rec.Code != want { t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, want) }
